name: crypto-idea
description: Crypto portfolio tracker & DCA calculator PWA

scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/stamp-sw.js && node scripts/check-dist-names.js
scripts.deploy: node scripts/check-env.js && npm run build && firebase deploy --project prod
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-crypto-idea "node --test --test-force-exit tests/data-layer.test.js tests/functions-callable.test.js"
scripts.test:rules:solo: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-crypto-idea --config firebase.solo.json "node --test tests/firestore-rules.test.js"
scripts.test:integration:solo: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-crypto-idea --config firebase.solo.json "node --test --test-force-exit tests/data-layer.test.js tests/functions-callable.test.js"
